test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the odd one out.
solution:
Here,

 
• 
 
**Oxygen, Hydrogen, and Nitrogen** are all pure, naturally occurring chemical elements found on the periodic table. They are also gases at room temperature.

 

While,

 
• 
 
**Steel** is not an element; it is a man-made **alloy** (a mixture of iron and carbon) and a solid metal at room temperature.

 

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
